description:
Get information and status about a BigQuery job.

Use this tool to check the status, statistics, or configuration of a job using its `jobId`.

inputSchema.description: Request for getting information about a job.

jobId.description: Required. Job ID of the requested job.

location.description: Required. The geographic location of the job.

projectId.description: Required. Project ID of the requested job.

name: google-bigquery__get_job
